newsitem.title: UK: HSBC Holdings slips after broker downgrade.
newsitem.headline: HSBC Holdings slips after broker downgrade.

text.p: Shares in banking group HSBC Holdings dropped over one percent on Tuesday, hit by its weaker close in Hong Kong and after Panmure Gordon cut its recommendation on the stock to "hold" from "buy", dealers said.
HSBC fell 22p or 1.7 percent to 1,269p in mid-morning in a genearally weaker UK market.
The Panmure downgrade was based on valuation considerations after the strong performance of the past quarter.
A technical squeeze had added to the recent upward pressure on the share price, said Panmure analyst David Poutney.
HSBC shares peaked at 13.13 stg recently, up from 929p at the beginning of May.
